flags.question: Which 3 users rated the movie with the highest revenue?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WITH m
ORDER BY m.revenue DESC
LIMIT 1
MATCH (u:User)-[r:RATED]->(m)
RETURN u.name, r.rating
ORDER BY r.rating DESC
LIMIT 3

flags.question: Find movies where the sum of the revenue and budget is more than 1 billion dollars.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (m:Movie)
WHERE (m.revenue + m.budget) > 1000000000
RETURN m.title AS title, m.revenue AS revenue, m.budget AS budget
details: Question asks for total/sum but TypeQL has no sum()

flags.question: Identify directors who have never directed a movie rated under 6 on IMDb.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (d:Director)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE m.imdbRating >= 6
WITH d, COUNT(m) AS totalMovies
MATCH (d)-[:DIRECTED]->(m2:Movie)
WITH d, totalMovies, COUNT(m2) AS directedMovies
WHERE totalMovies = directedMovies
RETURN d.name AS DirectorName
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: List all actors who have acted in movies with at least two different directors.
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(d:Director)
WITH a, m, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS directorCount
WHERE directorCount >= 2
RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS ActorName
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count

flags.question: Which 3 actors have played in both comedy and drama genres?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (a:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m1:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g1:Genre {name: "Comedy"}),
      (a)-[:ACTED_IN]->(m2:Movie)-[:IN_GENRE]->(g2:Genre {name: "Drama"})
WITH a, COUNT(DISTINCT m1) AS comedyMovies, COUNT(DISTINCT m2) AS dramaMovies
WHERE comedyMovies > 0 AND dramaMovies > 0
RETURN a.name AS actorName
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher uses COUNT() but TypeQL has no count
Cypher uses COUNT(DISTINCT) but TypeQL has no distinct (may be OK if groupby handles it)

flags.question: Which 3 users have rated both the oldest and the newest movies in the database?
flags.cypher:
// Find the oldest and newest movies
MATCH (oldestMovie:Movie)
WITH oldestMovie
ORDER BY oldestMovie.year ASC
LIMIT 1

MATCH (newestMovie:Movie)
WITH oldestMovie, newestMovie
ORDER BY newestMovie.year DESC
LIMIT 1

// Find users who have rated both the oldest and newest movies
MATCH (user:User)-[:RATED]->(oldestMovie)
MATCH (user)-[:RATED]->(newestMovie)
RETURN user.name AS userName, user.userId AS userId
LIMIT 3
details: Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: Which 3 actors have acted in both a highest and lowest grossing movie?
flags.cypher:
// Find the highest and lowest grossing movies
MATCH (highestGrossing:Movie)
WITH highestGrossing
ORDER BY highestGrossing.revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

MATCH (lowestGrossing:Movie)
WITH highestGrossing, lowestGrossing
ORDER BY lowestGrossing.revenue ASC
LIMIT 1

// Find actors who acted in both the highest and lowest grossing movies
MATCH (actor:Actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(highestGrossing)
MATCH (actor)-[:ACTED_IN]->(lowestGrossing)
RETURN actor.name AS actorName
LIMIT 3
details: Question uses superlative "highest" but TypeQL has no sort or max/min
Cypher has ORDER BY (before final RETURN) but TypeQL has no sort

flags.question: What are the top 5 movies that were directed by persons who were not primarily directors?
flags.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
  MATCH (p)-[:DIRECTED]->(:Movie)
  WITH p, count(*) AS directedCount
  MATCH (p)-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)
  WITH p, directedCount, count(*) AS actedCount
  WHERE directedCount > actedCount
}
RETURN m.title AS MovieTitle, m.imdbRating AS Rating
ORDER BY Rating DESC
LIMIT 5
details: Cypher uses NOT EXISTS/NOT() but TypeQL has no not{} block
